title: Let AI loose on Blender to build me a poker table
author: spacespacespapce
selftext: Missing some markings on the table but otherwise looks good.

comments.author: spacespacespapce
comments.body: Now just need a stack of coins on top

comments.author: MysteriousPepper8908
comments.body: It's an interesting experiment but I'd say it's missing a fair bit of what you'd expect from a pool table. I can see wanting something that can build from primitives for editability but I think it'll be a while before those workflows can compete with something like Meshy.

replies.author: spacespacespapce
replies.body:
I agree with you, esp when generating models quickly - text to mesh is always going to be faster than "building" your way up to a model.

This was made in an "express" mode - meant to be fast and low quality. I'm also playing around with a "Pro" mode that will take longer but give higher quality results. Not as detailed as Meshy today, but it's getting there step by step!

comments.author: Physical-Mission-867
comments.body: I for one am impressed on the shape it chose, unless you gave it those specifics.
